shared_elements: animal/body-part motifs combined with abstract signs
justification: The most specific possible overlap is the presence of sinuous snake-like forms and avian/feather-related motifs amid geometric details, but these are not rendered in the same clear forms or iconographic combinations. A is dominated by a single frontal, elaborate anthropomorphic figure with costume, headdress, staff-like object, and pendant details, whereas B is organized as horizontal registers of separate profile animals and signs with no comparable central figure or pose.
